نطن (form I)
# نَطِنُّ (naṭinnu) /na.tˤin.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of طَنَّ (ṭanna)
# نُطَنُّ (nuṭannu) /nu.tˤan.nu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of طَنَّ (ṭanna)
# نَطِنَّ (naṭinna) /na.tˤin.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of طَنَّ (ṭanna)
# نُطَنَّ (nuṭanna) /nu.tˤan.na/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive/
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
